exercises.title: Predict the result: the real outputs of Slot 3.3
exercises.problemHtml:
For each query on the five products, write the names returned, in order, separated by ", " (or none). All answers come from a real run on MongoDB 7.

This set has 1 table. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper, or by running the snippet on your own machine), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.

exercises.title: The queries of the slides: operators, regex, sort, skip and limit
exercises.problemHtml:
The collection db.products holds the five products of the slides (Laptop 25000, TV 40000, Router 2000, Scanner 5000, Printer 9000). Write these functions; each returns the array of matching documents (use db.products.find(...), which here returns an array-like cursor):

  • expensive() — price greater than 10000;
  • midRange() — 1000 < price < 10000, written with $and as on slide 25;
  • startsWith(letter) — Name starts with the given letter (a regex built from the argument);
  • endsWithEr() — Name ends with er;
  • page(n, size) — products sorted by price ascending, page n (1-based) of size items: sort, then skip, then limit.

And raiseEr() — add 125 to the price of every product whose name ends with er (updateMany + $inc) and return its modifiedCount.

Requirements

  • Comparison operators $gt, $lt; $and takes an array.
  • Regex anchors: ^ = start, $ = end. new RegExp('^' + letter) or { $regex: '^' + letter }.
  • Pagination: skip((n - 1) * size).
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Collection db.products chứa năm sản phẩm của slide (Laptop 25000, TV 40000, Router 2000, Scanner 5000, Printer 9000). Viết các hàm sau; mỗi hàm trả mảng tài liệu khớp (dùng db.products.find(...), ở đây trả về cursor dạng mảng):

  • expensive() — giá lớn hơn 10000;
  • midRange() — 1000 < giá < 10000, viết bằng $and như slide 25;
  • startsWith(letter) — Name bắt đầu bằng chữ cái truyền vào (regex dựng từ đối số);
  • endsWithEr() — Name kết thúc bằng er;
  • page(n, size) — sản phẩm xếp theo giá tăng dần, trang n (đếm từ 1), mỗi trang size món: sort, rồi skip, rồi limit.

Và raiseEr() — cộng 125 vào giá mọi sản phẩm có tên kết thúc bằng er (updateMany + $inc) rồi trả modifiedCount.

Yêu cầu

  • Toán tử so sánh $gt, $lt; $and nhận một mảng.
  • Mốc của regex: ^ = đầu, $ = cuối. new RegExp('^' + letter) hoặc { $regex: '^' + letter }.
  • Phân trang: skip((n - 1) * size).

   Answer: d) undefined — result is still a Promise (no await)

2. Which connection string does MongoDB Atlas give you?MongoDB Atlas đưa bạn dạng chuỗi kết nối nào?
   Answer: d) mongodb+srv://user:pwd@cluster0.xxxx.mongodb.net/…

   $lookup = left outer join: from, localField, foreignField, as.VI: $lookup = left outer join: from, localField, foreignField, as.

   Answer: b) the second matching document
